## 3. Objections on his direct

- **S14 to S15, S16:** hearsay as to what Llamanzares or his papers showed; Original Document Rule as to the contents of any contract or receipt (Rule 130 §3). Ask that they be stricken or given no weight absent the papers.

- **S20 ("nagpapatunay na sila ay nagbabayad ng partial payments para sa pagbili"):** his characterization; the receipts speak for themselves.

- **S10, S13 (what the SPA authorized):** the SPA speaks for itself; no objection to his saying it was shown to Gloria.

- **Exh. 5 offer:** demand the originals of the faint pages (cross binder Tab 10).
